reuse.why: No shared helper for the furthest-from-zero rule exists here (getScheduledAmount still averages), and rather than extracting one from computeSchedulePreviewTransactions the diff copies that inline expression.

duplication.why: The missing/number/range ternary is a verbatim copy of the one in shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.

placement.why: Computing the API field in scheduleModel.toExternal fits the API layer, but the amount rule itself belongs in shared/schedules.ts beside the preview logic.

scope.why: Minimal and focused, though it adds expectedAmount as an optional field on APIScheduleEntity, which is also the create/update input type.

maintainability.why: Two hand-maintained copies of the expected-amount rule, and an output-only field leaking into the input type, invite drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing shared function implements this rule in the tree; the only other implementation is inline in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions

disguised_duplication.where: The copy in api-models.ts toExternal is verbatim, not disguised
